description: This file defines the static class `Zend_Loader`, which provides methods for loading PHP classes and files within the Zend Framework. It includes functions for class autoloading, file inclusion, security checks, and handling include paths.

classes.name: Zend_Loader
classes.description: A static utility class for loading PHP classes and files according to Zend Framework standards.

methods.name: loadClass
methods.description: Loads a class from a PHP file based on class name and optional directories. Implements PSR-0 namespace-aware autoloading for Zend Framework classes.

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Includes a PHP file, with optional directory search and support for include_once. Performs a security check before including.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if a file is readable, considering include_path and platform-specific path rules.

methods.name: explodeIncludePath
methods.description: Splits the include_path into an array of directories, handling stream schemas on Unix systems.

methods.name: autoload
methods.description: Deprecated autoload method compatible with spl_autoload, triggers a warning and loads a class.

methods.name: registerAutoload
methods.description: Registers or unregisters a fallback autoloader with spl_autoload, utilizing Zend_Loader_Autoloader.

methods.name: _securityCheck
methods.description: Performs a security check on the filename to prevent exploits via illegal characters.

methods.name: _includeFile
methods.description: Internal method to include a file, either once or multiple times; deprecated.
